# The Economic Survey

<!-- STEP id="survey" -->
Every year the Ministry of Finance prepares the **Economic Survey of India**. It reviews how the economy did in the past year: farming, industry, services, jobs, prices, education, health and more.

<!-- STEP id="parliament" -->
The Survey is presented in Parliament before the Union Budget. It helps the people who make the Budget decide, and it explains the economy's data clearly to citizens.

<!-- STEP id="loop" -->
Then the year runs on the Budget's choices. What happens in that year becomes data for the next Survey. You can read the latest Survey at indiabudget.gov.in/economicsurvey.

**Every year: measure, plan, spend, then measure again.**
